row:
This channel teaches you advanced physiotherapy techniques with expert guidance from Dr. Chakshu.

The Courses We Offer In Physioneeds Academy Are -:
1) Tapedia Course 
2) Static & Dynamic Neuromuscular Stabilization (SDNS) Course
3) Sports Massage Course
4) Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation Course
5) Physioneeds Anatomical Fascial Line Taping™ Course
6) Krishna’s Kinetikinetic Manual Therapy (Periphery) / KKMT (Periphery) Course
7) International Certificate in Soft tissue Manual therapy Course
8) Instrument Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilisation Course
9) Dry Needling Course
10) Certification Program On Blood Flow Restriction Training Course
11) Certification In Advance Fitness And Sports Training Course
12) A TO Z Knee Course

All these courses are provided under Physioneeds Academy under the guidance Dr. Chakshu which makes it The Best Physiotherapy Academy In India. 

#physiotherapyeducation #physioneedsacademy #physiotherapycourse
